description: Voucher and Accounting intelligence graph mapping all GII GeM ERP voucher types, posting functions, debit/credit patterns, ledger impact, receivable/payable impact, cash/bank impact, GST impact, inventory impact, report dependencies, reversal rules, audit trail behavior, workflow alignment with WG-1, and database alignment with DG-1.

postingFunctions.safetyRule: Department return: Dr Inventory, Cr Cost of Goods Sold at average cost. Supplier return (owner decision CV, 10 Nov 2026 IST): Dr GRNI for unbilled units and Dr Trade Payables for billed units at the supplier's receipt prices, Cr Inventory at average cost, the gap to Purchase Price Variance. The return already reduces the payable by the goods value; no separate Debit Note for that value. Input GST on returned billed goods is not reversed by the return and its treatment is not yet decided (ask the accountant). A return with no order counts against later returns on any order. Pool limits: see docs/architecture/fsr-2a4-perpetual-inventory-policy.md section 6.
No accounting entries; stock ledger only (Transfer Out / Transfer In)
Requires sufficient stock balance; creates stock_outwards records; delegates COGS voucher to postStockOutward
Single routing point: billing→postSalesVoucher, procurement→postPurchaseVoucher, payment→postReceiptVoucher, expense→postExpenseAccrualsForOrder

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Sales/Invoice posting creates 3 ledger entries: Trade Receivables (Dr), Sales (Cr), Output GST (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: Reversal creates opposite entries with swapped debit/credit

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Purchase/Procurement posting creates 3 ledger entries: Purchase (Dr), Input GST (Dr), Trade Payables (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: Reversal creates opposite entries with swapped debit/credit

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Receipt posting creates 3-4 ledger entries: Cash/Bank (Dr), TDS Receivable (Dr if applicable), GST TDS Receivable (Dr if applicable), Trade Receivables (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: Reversal creates opposite entries + payment_allocation cleanup + cash_bank_ledger reversal

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Supplier Payment creates 2 ledger entries: Trade Payables (Dr), Cash/Bank (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: Reversal creates opposite entries + supplier_payment_allocation cleanup + cash_bank_ledger reversal

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Journal/Manual voucher creates 2+ user-defined ledger entries
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Opening Balance creates 2 ledger entries: Target Account (Dr/Cr), Opening Balance Suspense (opposite)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Standard running balance with opening balance included

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: COGS recognition creates 2 ledger entries: Cost of Goods Sold (Dr), Inventory (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Inventory delta = debit - credit (negative for credit); COGS delta = debit - credit (positive for debit)
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: No direct reversal (stock_outward cannot be reversed independently)

ledgerImpactPatterns.description: Expense accrual creates 2 ledger entries: Expense Head (Dr), Expense Payable (Cr)
ledgerImpactPatterns.runningBalanceRule: Debit accounts: delta = debit - credit; Credit accounts: delta = credit - debit
ledgerImpactPatterns.reversalBehavior: Reversed via reverseVoucher; source table posting_status set to Reversed

workflowAlignment.description: Work Order / Supply Order has no direct accounting impact. It is operational only.
Expense accruals may be created via postExpenseAccrualsForOrder. Results in Journal voucher (Dr Expense, Cr Expense Payable).
Procurement posting creates Purchase voucher (Dr Purchase/Input GST, Cr Trade Payables). Also supports Debit Note via guided voucher.
Goods Receipt creates stock ledger entries (quantity/valuation) but no accounting voucher. Inventory valuation impact tracked via weighted average cost.
Stock reservation is operational only. No accounting impact.
Delivery Challan confirmation creates stock outwards + COGS Journal voucher (Dr COGS, Cr Inventory) via postStockOutward.
CRAC is billing readiness only. No direct accounting impact unless separately posted.
Sales Invoice posting creates Sales voucher (Dr Trade Receivables, Cr Sales/Output GST) and creates receivable. Credit Note reverses the pattern.
Receivable tracking and ageing. Accounting impact already created at SALES_INVOICE_GST_INVOICE stage. RefreshReceivable updates balance after allocations.
Receipt posting creates Receipt voucher (Dr Cash/Bank/TDS, Cr Trade Receivables). Supplier Payment creates Payment voucher (Dr Trade Payables, Cr Cash/Bank).
Order closure is final status update. Profitability analysis is read-only reporting. No new accounting entries created.

databaseAlignment.usage: Ledger accounts master. Used by all posting functions as debit/credit targets. Referenced by voucher_lines.account_id and ledger_entries.account_id.
Voucher header. Central table for all accounting transactions. Stores voucher_type, status, source_module, source_id, financial_year_id.
Voucher line items. Stores individual debit/credit amounts with account_id, linked_party_type, linked_party_id.
Ledger entries. Core accounting data store. Used by trialBalance, profitLossReport, balanceSheetReport, gstSummary, gstRegisters. Stores running_balance.
Cash/bank transactional ledger. Updated by Receipt, Payment, Contra, and Journal (cash/bank accounts). Stores running balance.
Receivable tracking. Created by upsertReceivable after Sales posting. Settled by payment allocations. Balance refreshed by refreshReceivable.
Receipt-to-invoice payment allocation. Created by postReceiptVoucher/createReceiptAllocation. Soft-deleted on reversal.
Supplier payment records. Source table for Payment voucher posting. Posting_status=Posted after postSupplierPaymentVoucher.
Supplier payment-to-procurement allocation. Soft-deleted on reversal.
Financial year master. Used by createBalancedVoucher to validate open year. Status can be Open, Closed, Locked.
Opening balance records. Source for createOpeningBalance and createPartyOpeningBalance functions.
Year-end closing records. Created by closeFinancialYear. Report dependency for yearEndClosingReport.
Carry-forward entries from year-end closing. Report dependency for carryForwardReport.
Sales invoice records. Source table for Sales voucher posting. posting_status=Posted after postSalesVoucher.
Sales invoice line items. Used to compute taxable total, output GST. Referenced by orderProfitability.
Procurement/purchase records. Source table for Purchase voucher posting. posting_status=Posted after postPurchaseVoucher.
Procurement line items. Used to compute taxable total, input GST.
Department payment records. Source table for Receipt voucher posting.
Expense entry records. Source table for expense accrual Journal posting.
Stock ledger with quantity and value tracking. Weighted average cost calculation. Not directly accounting-protected but valuation impacts financials.
Guided voucher drafts. Status flow: Draft→Pending Review→Pending Approval→Approved→Posted. Posted via postGuidedVoucher.
Audit log. Records all posting, reversal, and approval activity. Non-accounting table.

auditTrailMapping.records: original voucher reversal, reversal voucher creation

accountingProtectionMapping.principle1: All accounting impact must flow through controlled posting functions.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle2: Generic CRUD must not write to accounting-protected tables.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle3: Debit total must equal credit total before posting.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle4: Voucher, voucher_lines, and ledger_entries must be created atomically.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle5: Trial Balance, P&L, and Balance Sheet must derive from ledger_entries.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle6: Reversal must not edit original ledger entries directly; it must create contra/reversal entries.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle7: Draft business records may be edited, but posted accounting records must be protected.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle8: Financial year lock must block posting.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle9: Audit log must record posting and reversal activity.
accountingProtectionMapping.principle10: KG-4 must remain read-only over all accounting behavior.

knownGaps.description: Cash/Bank Book report does not have a dedicated function in reportBuilders.js. Currently queryable via cash_bank_ledger table directly.
knownGaps.impact: No dedicated report function for cash/bank book summary
knownGaps.workaround: cashBankLedger table can be queried directly

knownGaps.description: Partly closed by FSR-2A4 (PR #4): stock adjustments and stock returns now post Journal vouchers; warehouse transfers still post none (the value only moves between warehouses). The rest of this graph is brought up to date in KG-4 v1.1 after the branch convergence (see docs/audit/in-house-audits-2026-10/2026-11-10-convergence/).
knownGaps.impact: Until KG-4 v1.1, other entries of this graph may still describe stock movements without their vouchers
knownGaps.workaround: Read src/main/services/inventoryService.js and docs/architecture/fsr-2a4-perpetual-inventory-policy.md for the current postings

knownGaps.description: Stock outward reversal (COGS) is not independently supported. Reversal requires reversing the entire delivery challan or sales invoice.
knownGaps.impact: Cannot reverse COGS entry without reversing the source transaction
knownGaps.workaround: Reverse the parent transaction (sales invoice or delivery challan)

knownGaps.description: Opening balances (account and party) have no reversal support. They represent historical baseline entries.
knownGaps.impact: Opening balance corrections require manual Journal adjustment
knownGaps.workaround: Use Journal voucher to correct opening balance errors

knownGaps.description: No report filters directly by financial_year. All period-based filtering uses dateFrom/dateTo parameters.
knownGaps.impact: Financial year boundary reporting relies on date range, not explicit FY linkage
knownGaps.workaround: Date range parameters provide equivalent filtering

knownGaps.description: Expense accrual settlement does not have a dedicated payment flow. Expense Payable is settled via manual Journal or not yet implemented payment flow.
knownGaps.impact: Expense Payable balance may accumulate without automated settlement
knownGaps.workaround: Manual Journal voucher to settle Expense Payable
